arabic text:
ZULM-O-SITAM KI INTEHA HAI
ZULM-O-SITAM KI INTEHA HAI
YEH KARBALA HAI, YEH KARBALA HAI
KAHIN PE SAR HAIN, KAHIN RIDA HAI
english translation text:
THIS IS THE EXTREME OF OPPRESSION AND CRUELTY
THIS IS THE EXTREME OF OPPRESSION AND CRUELTY
THIS IS KARBALA, THIS IS KARBALA
HERE LIE SEVERED HEADS, THERE LIE PLUNDERED VEILS

arabic text: GHAZI NAHI HAIN, AKBAR NAHI HAIN\nQASIM NAHI HAIN, ASGHAR NAHI HAIN\nAUR SHAH KA LAASHA TANHA PARA HAI
english translation text: GHAZI IS NO LONGER HERE, AKBAR IS NO LONGER HERE\nQASIM IS NO LONGER HERE, ASGHAR IS NO LONGER HERE\nAND THE SHAH'S BLESSED BODY LIES ALONE

arabic text: KARKE DAFAN, MASOOM ASGHAR\nSHABBIR ROYE, NANNI QABAR PAR\nASGHAR KE KHOON SE CHEHRA BHARA HAI
english translation text: AFTER BURYING INNOCENT ASGHAR\nSHABBIR WEPT BESIDE THE TINY GRAVE\nHIS FACE WAS COVERED WITH ASGHAR'S BLOOD

arabic text: DONO JAHAN, MUTTHI MEIN JISKE\nMAQTAL MEIN PYAASA, SHABBIR HAIN WOH\nHAL MIN KI TANHA DETA SADA HAI
english translation text: THE ONE WHO HOLDS BOTH WORLDS IN HIS GRASP\nTHAT SHABBIR STANDS THIRSTY IN THE BATTLEFIELD\nALONE, HE CALLS OUT: IS THERE ANY HELPER

arabic text: MAQTAL MEIN HAI JO FAKHR-E-YUSUF\nHAM-SHAKL-E-AHMAD, HAI NAAM AKBAR\nSEENE MEIN USKE TOOTI SINA HAI
english translation text: IN THE BATTLEFIELD LIES THE ONE WHO IS THE PRIDE OF YUSUF\nTHE LIKENESS OF AHMAD, WHOSE NAME IS AKBAR\nIN HIS CHEST A SPEAR HAS BROKEN

arabic text: ISLAM KI KHATIR LUTA HAI\nJOHAR, MOHAMMED KA HAI GHARANA\nAB SHAAM KO YEH GHAR CHALA HAI
english translation text: FOR THE SAKE OF ISLAM, IT HAS BEEN PLUNDERED\nO JOHAR, THIS IS THE HOUSEHOLD OF MOHAMMED\nNOW THIS HOUSEHOLD IS BEING LED TO SHAAM
